scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.start: concurrently "bun run --cwd backend start" "bun run --cwd frontend start"
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd backend && bun install --cwd frontend
